scope: Seven dedicated wounded idle/walk sets; unverified until native and runtime review

shi_qian.identity: Slim Chinese man, alert eyes, black wrapped headcloth and black nose/mouth mask, charcoal cross-over cloth tunic and trousers, dark shin wraps and cloth boots. NO sack, backpack or weapon. Keep mask and narrow unarmored body.

shi_xiu.identity: Lean clean-shaven Chinese man, black topknot and dark blue-green tied forehead cloth with trailing ends; blue-gray cross-over long-sleeved tunic with pale inner collar, brown cloth/leather waist belt, gray-brown trousers, dark wrapped boots. Preserve current walking-body face and clothing, REMOVE both curved sabers, sheaths and combat stance.

qin_ming.identity: Broad powerful middle-aged man, curly black beard, red wrapped headscarf with small gold band, red robe/scarf, dark bronze armor with distinctive gold beast-face shoulders, dark trousers, gold-trim boots and quiet dark-red cloak. FOOT ONLY; NO horse, mace, weapon or rope.

yang_lin.identity: Lean man, pointed short black beard and moustache, blue-black tied headscarf, tan LEOPARD-SPOTTED fur tunic and pale short rolled sleeves, blue sash, dark blue shin wraps and cloth boots. Preserve spots not tiger stripes. No helmet or weapon.

huang_xin.identity: Stern middle-aged man, full dark beard, ochre headband and dark topknot, ochre tunic/scarf, black-brown lamellar armor with gold rivets/shoulder edges, dark trousers, ochre shin wraps/boots. NO back banner, writing, pole or sword.

wang_ying.identity: Distinctly SHORT STOCKY man, broad round face, short dark beard/moustache, dark topknot and rust-red tied headband, rust-red tunic, brown leather lamellar torso/shoulders with brass studs, broad belt, dark trousers, short boots. Stout compact legs. No helmet, sabers or sheaths.

deng_fei.identity: Rugged tawny Chinese man with thick curly black hair and beard, rust-brown hair tie, brown ragged shoulder scarf, brown leather/lamellar armor with brass round chest ornament, rust-red sash, dark trousers/boots. Natural intense reddish-brown eyes, NO glow, iron chain or weapons.
